QuestInfo.name: Missing Crewman
QuestInfo.0: Gold Richie urgently requests your help. See Gold Richie to find out what's going on.
QuestInfo.1: Gold Richie tells you that a crewman from his trade ship left two days ago to meet an old friend and never came back. He is worried that the crewman might be lost somewhere. Gold Richie wants you to find the crewman and use the #b#t2030000##k to send him to the nearest town.\n\n#i2030000##t2030000# #b#c2030000##k/1
QuestInfo.2: You found the crewman lost in the middle of a dungeon and sent him back safely.

0.0: I want you to find someone. Can you handle that?

yes.0: While our trading ship was anchored at the dock, a Crewman went out to meet an old friend, but...he hasn't returned.
yes.1: He is a very proficient sailor and very diligent when it comes to his work. But oddly enough, he's completely clueless when he's on land. I'm worried that he might be wandering around somewhere dangerous.
yes.2: I'm begging you, please find my friend. When you find the Crewman, give him the #bTown Return Pass#k, so he can return to the nearest town.

no.0: All you need to do is find someone... Will you reconsider?

1.0: I'm sorry, but where am I? I looked at the map, and I still can't figure it out. I don't know how i got here... *sniffle sniffle*
1.1: Hmm? Gold Richie sent you here? Phew, what a relief! I didn't know how I'd get back... There's no one here.
1.2: A Return Scroll? Thank you! Now I can finally go back. I'm going to shower and eat as soon as I get back. I've been lost for a few days now, and I feel so disgusting. Not to mention how hungry I am!

yes.0: Land is such a scary place to be... I'm going back. Thank you so much for helping me. Oh! When I go back, I'll make sure to tell Gold Richie how helpful you were.

item.0: Oh, how will I ever return...
